definition: The state of a reversible reaction in a closed system where the forward and backward reactions continue at equal rates, so the concentrations of reactants and products stay constant.
A reaction whose products can react to re-form the reactants, so it can go in both directions; it is written with the $\rightleftharpoons$ arrow.
The value $K$ of the equilibrium expression for a reaction at equilibrium; a large $K$ means mostly products, a small $K$ mostly reactants, and only a change of temperature changes it.
The rule for writing $K$ from a balanced equation: product concentrations over reactant concentrations, each raised to the power of its coefficient.
